caption: The drawing depicts a snake with a long, coiled body that appears to be impaled by a vertical, double-pointed stake or spear running through two of its coils. The snake is colored with varying shades of brown and green, with darker spots and patterns along its length. The snake’s body loops in a loose, almost horizontally-oriented series of curves, with its head extended to the right and its tail trailing off to the left. The spear or stake is brown with pointed tips protruding both above and below the snake. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Serpent Weather Vane
